items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The mention of Lloyd Land is made by the [INTERVIEWER], not the [INTERVIEWEE]. The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond with personal details or confirmation of a relationship.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. Then Lloyd, Lloyd Land helped me out some, with some parts, you know. Oh, I see.
I see. I just wonder, because so many people arrange at the piano and...
